quote: Sometimes the silence speaks louder than words. You keep your distance to protect your peace. Not everyone deserves access to your fragile heart. People only see the mask you wear. They never notice the quiet storm inside. You wait for someone to finally understand you. But some pain is meant to be carried alone.
